Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)

OverviewSupport periodResponsibilitySBOMDeclarationAdvisoriesSecure useFAQ

The EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847) sets cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements placed on the EU market. This page explains how WIZnet supports customers who design WIZnet chips and modules into their products.

At a glance

Notification commitmentEarly notice within 24 hours*, details within 72 hours*, final report within 14 days of a fix*.See the commitment FAQStandard answers to the questions customers ask when they assess suppliers for the CRA.Read the FAQ Secure use guidanceHow to integrate and operate WIZnet products securely, and how to apply updates.Open the guidance

Timeline

  • 11 September 2026: Reporting obligations for actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents apply.
  • 11 December 2027: The CRA applies in full, including conformity assessment and CE marking.
